definition: Status answers whether the verification held; tier answers whether the row fits the practice. Scale or fit demotion with verification held → Reclassified; control demotion → Verified; Downgraded means the verification failed or the row is out. Public or PE control in the note → Tier C, Downgraded.
contradiction_method: a note contradicts itself where its own disposition clauses send the row to different tiers, or where it states a public/PE disqualifier and also an independent/no-sponsor finding; 0 rows met either test
